items.title: BEEAH授出1.75亿迪拉姆基础设施工程，推进Khalid Bin Sultan City建设
items.title_en: BEEAH awards AED175 million infrastructure package for Khalid Bin Sultan City
items.sector: 城市基础设施与房地产
items.summary: BEEAH正式委任Building Co. (BEST) L.L.C.承担Khalid Bin Sultan City一期约345,500平方米的基础设施工程，覆盖A、B、G区域及园区公共设施，计划2028年第四季度完成。1.75亿迪拉姆是已授予基础设施工程合同金额。
items.summary_en: BEEAH appointed Building Co. (BEST) L.L.C. for an AED175 million infrastructure package covering about 345,500 sqm across Phase 1 Orbits A, B and G and site-wide works, scheduled for completion in Q4 2028.
items.why_it_matters: 基础设施分包、施工劳务、道路及管网、机电设备和工程材料。
items.why_it_matters_en: BEEAH appointed Building Co. (BEST) L.L.C. for an AED175 million infrastructure package covering about 345,500 sqm across Phase 1 Orbits A, B and G and site-wide works, scheduled for completion in Q4 2028.

items.title: Hutchison Ports Sohar宣布投资2.35亿美元扩建集装箱码头
items.title_en: Hutchison Ports Sohar announces USD235 million container terminal expansion
items.summary: Hutchison Ports Sohar公布向Terminal C新增2.35亿美元扩建投资，计划引入电动起重机和无人驾驶运输车辆，相关设备预计2027年到港。截至2026年11月初，码头年内箱量约100万TEU，同比增长约40%。该金额为扩建投资而非已授予单个设备或工程合同。
items.summary_en: Hutchison Ports Sohar announced a further USD235 million investment in Terminal C, including electric cranes and autonomous vehicles expected in 2027. The terminal had handled around one million TEU by early November, up about 40% year on year.
items.why_it_matters: 港口设备、自动化物流、工程配套、仓储运输及工业维护。
items.why_it_matters_en: Hutchison Ports Sohar announced a further USD235 million investment in Terminal C, including electric cranes and autonomous vehicles expected in 2027. The terminal had handled around one million TEU by early November, up about 40% year on year.

items.title: EGA推进本地工业供应商培育，10家创业企业进入专项辅导
items.title_en: EGA completes Ramp-Up programme supporting 10 entrepreneur businesses
items.sector: 工业采购与供应商培育
items.summary: Emirates Global Aluminium完成第四期Ramp-Up计划，支持10家创业企业通过培训与辅导提升参与未来工业采购的能力。EGA每年向阿联酋本地供应商采购超过80亿迪拉姆商品和服务；该金额为其既有年度采购支出，不是本期新签订单。
items.summary_en: EGA completed the fourth Ramp-Up season supporting 10 entrepreneurs to compete for future supplier opportunities. Its existing annual procurement from UAE suppliers exceeds AED8 billion; this is not a new contract award.
items.why_it_matters: 工业供应商准入、制造业服务、设备维护与B2B采购合作。

items.title: 迪拜国际商会举行Big 5建筑业投资说明会，推广绿色建材和智慧施工
items.title_en: Dubai International Chamber highlights construction investment prospects at Big 5
items.summary: Dubai International Chamber于Big 5 Global期间举办建筑行业商务说明会，吸引155名国际企业代表参加，介绍迪拜基础设施、交通、航空及房地产开发等领域的机遇，并讨论可持续建材和先进施工技术。会议不等于新工程合同授标。
items.summary_en: Dubai International Chamber hosted a business briefing alongside Big 5 Global for 155 representatives of international firms, outlining opportunities in infrastructure, transport, aviation, property development and sustainable construction. No new contract award was reported.

items.title: 迪拜国际商会波兰商务代表团对接美妆、家电与食品加工企业
items.title_en: Dubai International Chamber's Poland mission explores beauty, appliance and food partnerships
items.summary: 迪拜国际商会波兰贸易代表团推进欧洲市场合作，企业洽谈涉及电子家电、农业生产、食品加工、香水、化妆品和个人护理产品，并探索出口、分销、制造及合资合作。报道未披露已成交合同总额。
items.summary_en: Dubai International Chamber's mission to Poland explored bilateral partnerships across electronics, appliances, agriculture, food processing, fragrances, cosmetics and personal care. Discussions do not imply signed procurement contracts.

items.title: Expo City Dubai与迪拜市政府合作推进城市公园与公共空间绿化
items.title_en: Expo City Dubai and Dubai Municipality partner on greener urban spaces
items.summary: Expo City Dubai与Dubai Municipality签署战略合作，通过Terra可持续发展中心推动城市公园与公共空间的自然生态融合、环境监测及社区参与。当前为合作框架，并未披露具体施工合同金额。
items.summary_en: Expo City Dubai and Dubai Municipality signed a partnership to integrate nature and biodiversity across parks and public spaces through Terra-led environmental and community programmes. No specific construction contract was announced.
items.why_it_matters: 城市景观、绿化设施、公共空间设计、养护和市政服务。

items.title: 阿曼Tatweer平台推出农业项目提案服务，允许投资者在线选地申请
items.title_en: Oman launches Tatweer service for agricultural investment proposals
items.summary: 阿曼住房与城市规划部推出Tatweer平台的“Propose Your Project”服务，投资者可通过互动地图选择地块并线上提交农业项目资料，随后按官方标准审查。该入口不是已获批的土地协议或投资项目。
items.summary_en: Oman's Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning launched a Tatweer online service allowing investors to select government land via an interactive map and submit agricultural project proposals for review. Applications are not approvals.
items.why_it_matters: 农业加工、食品供应链、仓储冷链、土地开发和企业落地。

items.title: 阿曼科技企业在Africa Tech Festival签署约1,100万美元合作协议
items.title_en: Omani tech firms sign approximately USD11 million agreements at Africa Tech Festival
items.summary: 阿曼科技企业在11月17—19日于开普敦举行的Africa Tech Festival期间签署三项合作协议，总额约1,100万美元，涉及科技产品、数字服务和非洲市场拓展。11月24日披露的是此前活动的签约成果。
items.summary_en: Omani technology companies signed three cooperation agreements worth about USD11 million in total at Africa Tech Festival in Cape Town on 17–19 November, reported on 24 November. These are agreements, not necessarily delivered revenue.
items.why_it_matters: 企业软件、人工智能服务、技术出海及阿曼—非洲市场合作。
